description.p: AWG Tunnel connects to WireGuard and AmneziaWG servers entirely in userspace and exposes the tunnel as a local SOCKS5 proxy. It needs no root access, no kernel module and no system service, which makes it suitable for immutable and image-based systems.
Obfuscation parameters are read directly from your profile and passed to the tunnel engine unchanged, so configurations exported from an existing AmneziaWG server work as they are.

ul.li: Imports standard wg-quick and awg-quick configuration files
Supports AmneziaWG obfuscation, including junk packets, packet padding and magic header ranges
Reports genuine connection state from the tunnel's own handshake and traffic counters
Verifies that traffic really leaves through the tunnel
Stores private keys in the system keyring

description.p: Please note: this is a proxy, not a system-wide VPN. Only applications that you point at the proxy are tunnelled, and there is no kill switch. Applications that ignore the proxy continue to use your normal connection.
